{{Top|leg}}
'''Midshipmen''' were were individuals who served aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Some known midshipmen included [[Koth Barak]], [[Gasto]] and [[Brandis (midshipman)|Brandis]].

Within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], a midshipman was the lowest officer position. The specific rank, depending on whether the officer in the Navy was a line officer or a specialist officer, was an Ensign or simply an Officer, respectively.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] most of the advanced training for naval officer candidates was part of their time served as midshipmen on active vessels with the midshipmen serving in a variety of roles, receiving training from the ship's officers, and studying engagements the vessel had fought in. They often asked the ship's officers questions about the decisions they made during prior battles and why those decisions were made as well.
